title: Finite Relational Grid Obstacle Pilot V0
run_context: controlled gridworld obstacle-insertion study generated by omega.validation.finite_relational_grid_obstacle
claim_boundary: Synthetic gridworld adapter empirics over a declared 3x3 finite grid. This validates that a generated grid source can compile into finite relational IR and expose hidden reachability loss under stale abstraction. It does not validate a real substrate, infer agency, prove value, certify identity, or validate Omega.

study.question: How often do generated obstacle insertions hide exact source-target reachability loss when the abstract transition is stale?

interpretation: This is an instrumented source-generator pilot, not a hand-written low-level IR fixture.

The generator declares a grid interface and source-target pair, generates obstacle insertions, compiles before/after/stale abstract transitions, and certifies hidden loss with the existing generic audit.
The study is still synthetic finite empirics; it demonstrates adapter machinery over a generated source class, not real-world alignment evidence.
